The service from Solar and Batteries Direct has been very good.  The sales consultant Des has been good to deal with, very pleasant.  He came to our house and explained things clearly and provided a quote in the time frame expected.  We really appreciated that he did not hassle us while we were getting other quotes and making our comparisons and decision.  The installation process was very smooth.  The installers arrived on time and completed the job in the expected time frame.  They communicated with us during the installation so we knew what was happening.  The change with our grid connection and meter board has occurred as expected.  I recommend Des and Solar and Batteries Direct.
